title: A voi s'inchina
subtitle: Ferrando, Guglielmo, Fiordiligi, Dorabella, Despina and Don Alfonso: Act 2 finale (No. 31), section 8, from Così fan tutte

passages.label: Ed al magnetico signor dottore · Stelle, che veggo! · Ecco là il barbaro
V'ingannai · Qua le destre · Tutti quattro ora ridete
Idol mio, se questo è vero · Te lo credo · Io non so se veglio o sogno

licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: Cavaliere, dell' Albania and coll' amore as two words, Signora, Signor Dottore, Quà, gioja, vò, fò, the men's added “no”, Despina's “ch'a molt' altri” the first time and “che a molt' altri” after, and the sisters' “babaro” for barbaro, a print slip.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 352–358, bars 496–575 of No. 31
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the No. 31 Finale (671 bars) read in fourteen page ranges, sung lines and piano each by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the zoomed page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by eight fresh proofreaders (pages 353–359 clean). The German singing translation is left out. All the singers of this section have a staff throughout, with rests where the print leaves a staff out; singers who do not sing in this section are left out. Cut from the one-file finale at bars 496–575: from the Allegretto at the top of p. 352 to the bar of rest with a fermata before the Allegro molto. In bars 19 and 22 the print puts a natural sign on the trills (Ferrando, Guglielmo and the piano); the file has plain trills. Playback tempo: Allegretto at ♩ = 100, Andante (3/8) from bar 6 at ♩ = 60, Allegretto from bar 14 at ♩ = 100, Andante con moto (alla breve) from bar 36 at ♩ = 120, from René Jacobs's recording (harmonia mundi), whose track for this section and the one before lasts 4:45 (this section about 2¼ minutes).
